admin_spend_total.label: Total administrative spend
admin_spend_total.description: Administrative spending as supplied by a county commissioner in the initiative's request workbook. Not an audited figure.

admin_spend_yoy_pct.label: Administrative spend, year-over-year change
admin_spend_yoy_pct.description: Computed by this pipeline from the stated totals.

admin_spend_change_pct_since.label: Administrative spend, total change over the period
admin_spend_change_pct_since.description: First to last fiscal year in the stated series.

capital_project_original_budget.label: Capital project — original budget
capital_project_original_budget.description: Budget when the project was first approved.

capital_project_current_budget.label: Capital project — current budget
capital_project_current_budget.description: Most recent budget for the same project.

general_fund_surplus_deficit.label: General Fund surplus / (deficit)
general_fund_surplus_deficit.description: Negative values are deficits. Shown in the source in parentheses.

general_fund_balance_available_cash.label: General Fund balance — available cash
general_fund_balance_available_cash.description: The town's savings. Its stated floor is 50% of expenditures.

general_fund_balance_pct_of_expenditures.label: Fund balance as % of expenditures
general_fund_balance_pct_of_expenditures.description: The town states its aim is to stay no lower than 50%.

revenue_per_cent_of_tax_rate.label: Revenue raised by one cent of tax rate
revenue_per_cent_of_tax_rate.description: The town's own conversion factor. Powers the household cost estimate.

salary_benefit_increase_cost.label: Cost of salary and benefit increases

tax_rate_increase_needed_cents.label: Tax rate increase needed to balance
tax_rate_increase_needed_cents.description: Stated by the town as a floor ('over N cents').

capital_projects_tax_rate_equivalent_cen.label: Major capital projects, expressed as tax-rate cents

tax_rate_above_revenue_neutral_cents.label: Tax rate above the revenue-neutral rate
tax_rate_above_revenue_neutral_cents.description: Revenue-neutral is the rate raising the same revenue after a revaluation. The gap above it is the effective increase.
